I.effect_boundary: Each live scenario requires a concrete controlled target and instruction; no ambient or batch calling.

F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Verify the full speak-to-0102, call-in-Japanese, report-result prototype in its actual host.
steps: Identify the actual host and prove phone tool discovery, authenticated route and persistent journal availability.
Capture a real microphone instruction, inspect resolved recipient and Japanese message, and execute under the bound instruction authority.
Test both human and voicemail delivery with controlled recipients; correlate host request, provider conversation and recipient evidence.
Use isolated offline failure injection for crash/timeout/negation paths; verify live duplicate suppression without additional dialing.
Report outcome honestly to 012, including unconfirmed delivery when no direct confirmation exists.
acceptance: Real microphone capture and real model inference reach the governed phone tool.
Human and mailbox confirm full Japanese message delivery through this host path.
The returned result correlates with the actual request and does not overclaim success.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
